fields.description: Issue dated May 11, 1935 (Vol. 9, No. 34) featuring prominent coverage of Miami-area politics and civic affairs, including discussion of a recall effort against Mayor Sewell and commentary on city commission candidates. Major articles include an account alleging wage and hour violations and an assault involving a Miami-Biltmore hotel kitchen worker and hotel personnel in Coral Gables, and a campaign against illegal small-loan "loan shark" practices with statements from local corporations refusing to honor salary assignments. Additional columns and advertisements cover Mothers' Day, local sports (boxing), University of Miami campus notes, and assorted local news and commentary.
